answer: Credit counts only from provably unrelated peers. Each epoch seeds identities uniquely, so an answer is a fingerprint, not a template. Grading walks the attestation graph: a vouch counts only from a grader on a separate branch, with no shared funding or ancestry. A sybil farm is a dense cluster, so its vouches collapse onto one branch, earning one voice, not a thousand. Faking independence means growing history on many branches and paying rent on each; shortcuts leave a visible ridge where histories should be flat. Reputation, like timber, grows in rings; a prism multiplies colors, not light.
